name: Ultralight Grey Oak Slats, Black Felt
summary: Grey Oak real wood veneer laminated onto 9 mm recycled black acoustic felt. The panel has no MDF, hardwood, or other rigid core.

texture.note: Manufacturer specs override photo estimates: seven 1.20 in faces with 0.49 in 90-degree V-grooves on a 1.69 in pitch, 6.2 mm groove depth and 9 mm total coreless veneer/felt depth; these stated widths sum to an 11.83 in repeat versus the rounded 11.80 in panel listing. Grey oak tone is sampled from main.jpg, with procedural grain and black felt; the tile covers seven pitches by 25.35 in with half-grooves at the horizontal boundaries.
